_comment: A caller gates on it without reading the code: factoryctl turns a 2 into a
send-back with `findings` as evidence and a 10 into a stopped phase, and
stores `audit.hash` in its own chain. A check id renamed, a status added, or
a key dropped is therefore a contract change, and this file is the third
point that makes it deliberate: packages/gnomon-cli/src/check.test.ts asserts
the code's CHECK_IDS / CHECK_STATUSES, the table in CONTRACTS.md §6 and the
lists here are the same sets, and validates a document the real binary

exit_codes.0: every check that applied held, and at least one check inspected something
exit_codes.2: a check failed: the work is wrong (wins over 10 when both occur)
exit_codes.10: no verdict: a check could not run, the run stopped early, or nothing was inspected
